subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor RFC 0016’s core Claw mutation and provenance lifecycle now, and require this slice to land only as part of an ordered recovery-capable stack?
rationale: Patch correctness cannot decide whether OpenClaw should adopt new core CLI, manifest, persistent ownership, consent, upgrade, and partial-recovery contracts; the protected label and open RFC require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Pause pending RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the draft open without further landing work until maintainers accept or narrow the durable Claw lifecycle contract.

options.title: Sponsor the ordered stack
options.body: Approve the direction, merge the read-only base first, restack this PR, and require status/remove or doctor recovery coverage before enabling the lifecycle beyond its experimental gate.

options.title: Decline the core lifecycle
options.body: Close the associated implementation stack if Claws should remain outside OpenClaw core or move to another extension surface.

recommendation.title: Pause pending RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open without further landing work until maintainers accept or narrow the durable Claw lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most detailed visible product-model and safety review for this exact lifecycle slice and are the strongest discussion-backed owner for the contract question.
